tooltip_definitions.Data Center & AI (DCAI): Xeon server processors, Gaudi AI accelerators, and cloud hyperscaler infrastructure silicon.
tooltip_definitions.Client Computing (CCPG): Core Ultra processors (Lunar Lake, Arrow Lake) for AI PCs, enterprise laptops, and gaming desktops.
tooltip_definitions.Intel Foundry: Internal fab manufacturing and external advanced packaging (CoWoS, EMIB) for commercial foundry customers.
tooltip_definitions.Intersegment Eliminations: Elimination of internal silicon wafer transfer billings between Intel Foundry and product business units.
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Gross Margin: Gross margin adjusted for fab startup costs, patent amortization, and restructuring charges (43.0% in Q3).
tooltip_definitions.Operating Income (EBIT): Consolidated operating profit ($2,522.0M in Q3 2026, 15.27% operating margin).
tooltip_definitions.True FCF: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures, stock-based compensation, and lease obligations ($1,074.0M in Q3).
tooltip_definitions.Q4 Guidance Reset: Severe sequential margin warning: Q4 Gross Margin guided down to 38.0% and EPS to $0.25 (vs $0.52 in Q3).
tooltip_definitions.18A Process Node: Intel's next-generation 1.8nm manufacturing process featuring RibbonFET transistors and PowerVia backside power.
tooltip_definitions.Lunar Lake: High-efficiency mobile SoC designed for AI laptops, utilizing external TSMC N3B packaging before transitioning in-house.
tooltip_definitions.Gaudi 3: Cost-effective AI training and inference accelerator competing against Nvidia H100/H200 in enterprise clusters.
tooltip_definitions.Research & Development: Expenditures on advanced extreme ultraviolet (High-NA EUV) lithography and packaging tooling ($3,490M in Q3).
tooltip_definitions.Cost of Sales: Silicon wafer fabrication materials, packaging yield scrap, cleanroom depreciation, and utility power ($9,417M in Q3).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Diluted EPS: Net profit divided by diluted common shares ($0.60 per share in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Diluted EPS: Adjusted earnings per share ($0.52 vs $0.40 consensus hurdle, beating by +$0.12).
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Flow: Cash generated by semiconductor deliveries and hyperscaler customer deposits ($13,184M 9M YTD).
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditures: Investment in fab construction across Ohio, Oregon, Ireland, and Magdeburg Germany ($10,216M 9M YTD).
tooltip_definitions.CHIPS Act Funding: Direct federal subsidies and manufacturing investment tax credits supporting U.S. fab buildouts.
tooltip_definitions.Enterprise Value: Consolidated market capitalization adjusted for net debt and cash balances ($500.86B at regular close).
tooltip_definitions.Options Volatility Regime: 9.12% straddle implied move breached decisively by actual -23.00% post-market gap down to $70.89.
